source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 22 iunie — «Sfântul Mucenic Galaction»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 22ης Ιουνίου — «Άγιος Γαλατίων»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 22 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and gives no year. It spells the name «Γαλατίων (ή Γαλακτίων)», the second form being the one the corpus's Romanian line «Galaction» answers to, and he is none of the corpus's four other men of the name — the disciple of Martinian, the one of Emesa, the one of Vologda and the twentieth-century Romanian. The page adds the one thing the Romanian source lacked, that he was drowned; the same day's Πομπιανός is drowned in the same words and is a separate entry. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence, and the page prints no hymn under his line.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).
